# The crosshair and Type animation fixes of fix/cross108. Compare the branch with main by running it twice.
# Parts 1 and 2 on 1.21.11, part 3 on 1.21.1 (the only version where it differs):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/cross108 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/cross108.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/cross108 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/cross108.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/cross108 -f version=1.21.1 -f script=.github/checks/cross108.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/cross108 -f version=1.21.1 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/cross108.txt
#
# 1 (type-fast_*): Lines layout, Type animation, only the line being sung, two made-up lines of about 90 letters (two
#   rows) that each last 1.5 s, sung faster than they type. Frame 00 is just after a seek 1.15 s into a line; the line
#   after it starts about 0.35 s later (frame 01 or 02). Fixed: frame 00 already shows most of the line (what has been
#   sung), and in the later frames the typed letters keep up with the karaoke fill, the whole line typed by its end.
#   Main: frame 00 shows a blank or a letter or two (the seek restarted the typing), and the typing stays behind the
#   fill: the last frames show only about half of the new line, its second row missing.
# 2 (type-rtl_*): made-up Hebrew lines, a seek 3.75 s into one, the next starting about 0.25 s later (frame 02 or 03).
#   Both: the new line types from the right, its first (rightmost) word first; the right-to-left order already worked.
#   Frames 00 to 02 differ like part 1: fixed, the line seeked into is nearly all there; main, it starts typing again.
# 3 (flash-first_*, flash-hidden_*): a blue Dot crosshair with Flash with the lyrics on. Look at the crosshair's middle
#   pixel's colour across the frames (a pixel check, too faint to see well by eye). Fixed: the same colour in every
#   frame. Main: flash-first_00 to about _04 a little brighter (up to about 20 levels in red) right after new lyrics
#   come in, and in flash-hidden (lyrics switched off) a few frames brighter right after the seek and after the line
#   change about 0.35 s later.
# 4 (meter-*, 1.21.1 only): the attack meter under the crosshair, just after taking an axe. meter-normal is the game's
#   own crosshair for reference. Fixed: meter-cross shows the same see-through inverted meter as meter-normal. Main
#   (1.21.1): under the Cross the meter is a solid dark grey bar with a plain white fill. On 1.21.11 both look the same.

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -22
sleep 6

# 1: a fast long line with the Type animation
set layout LINES
set animation TYPEWRITER
set karaoke true
set showPrevious false
set showNext false
fastlines 1500 Racing past the neon towers while the city lights keep spinning round and round us all night long | Every single window flashing like a signal calling out to everyone who waits below the glowing sky
sleep 1
seek 29.5
burst type-fast 9 200
wait burst type-fast wrote
where

# 2: right to left
lines האורות דולקים מעל העצים הגבוהים בלילה | כל בלוק זוהר בשקט מתחת לכוכבים
sleep 1
seek 7.6
burst type-rtl 8 100
wait burst type-rtl wrote

# 3: no faint flash without a new line
set animation WORDS
set showPrevious true
set showNext true
set colorMode FIXED
set color 3368652
set crosshair DOT
set crosshairPulse true
sleep 2
lines Quiet test line one | Quiet test line two
burst flash-first 12 50
wait burst flash-first wrote
set enabled false
sleep 2
seek 7.5
burst flash-hidden 20 50
wait burst flash-hidden wrote
set enabled true

# 4: the attack meter (1.21.1), with the game's crosshair and with the Cross
look 0 -35
sleep 2
set crosshair NORMAL
cmd item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:wooden_axe
sleep 0.4
shot meter-normal
set crosshair CROSS
cmd item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone_axe
sleep 0.4
shot meter-cross
cmd item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air
set crosshair NORMAL
set crosshairPulse false
